chunks: When they realise it has come upon them, distraught will be the faces of unbelievers. They will be told: "This is what you asked for."
ai.seo_question: What happens to the faces of the disbelievers when they see the reality they claimed?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Mulk, this verse captures the psychological collapse of the disbelievers as they confront the tangible reality of the Hereafter, contrasting their worldly arrogance with their ultimate despair. Shia exegetes often highlight the phrase 'what you were calling for' as a direct response to their specific claims of divine power or resurrection, emphasizing the irony of their expectation versus the actual experience. This moment serves as a pivotal warning that the truth they mocked will become an undeniable, inescapable reality.
